tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnam 'phyang chu stod sa paṇa 'khrungs tshes thog gser khrir skyabs mgon gdung mchog nas rnam 'grel gzhung skyor mdzad skabs 'phan 'bul ba'i zhal byang bzhugs so// na mo gu ru sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ thugs bskyed rgya mtshor byin rlabs rgya mtsho rin chen mdzod 'dzin rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma bka' drin can/ /ye shes rgya mtshor dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter kun mnga' ba mchog thun yi dam sangs rgyas chos tshogs dang / /mthu stobs rgya mtshor dam bca' zhal bzhis rgya mtsho'i bstan srung nor lha la sogs phul byung lha tshogs ji snyed la/ /skye dgu rgya mtshor tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho zad mi shes phyir pad rag mdangs ldan rin chen gser ris 'phan/ /'di sogs dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin/ /rab 'byams zhing khams bkang ba'i dad mos ltar/ /rmad byung skyabs mchog rnams kyis de bzhin du/ /bdag dang 'gro la dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa spyi dang bye brag rgyas/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu zhabs brtan bzhed dgongs 'grub/ /'jig rten bde zhing kun kyang 'phral yun dge /rnam dag smon pa'i gnas rnams mthar phyin shog /khyad par lha rigs 'khon gdung sa skya pa'i/ /gdung rabs sangs rgyas byang sems mkhas grub kyi/ /rnam sprul rgyun mi chad par byon nas kyang / /mdo sngags rig gnas shes bya kun 'phel shog /de kun nyer 'tshe'i mun pas mi bsgribs par/ /sku tshe mdzad 'phrin gdung brgyud legs tshogs kyi/ /yon tan nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dge legs 'od/ /rtag brtan srid zhi'i pad tshal cher rgyas shog /ces 'di rnam 'phyang chu stod nyer lnga la/ /gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya yi/ /lha chen sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang chen gyi/ /gser khrir bzhugs nas rnam 'grel gzhung gsung tshe/ /lo zla de yi sa paṇa 'khrungs tshes mchod/ /rgyas par phul dus rten 'brel lhun grub tu/

/chos kyi grags pas snyan 'byung mnga' dbus ljongs/ /rang 'grigs 'di ltar de don lhun 'grub shog /ces pa'ang sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyis te/ rab gnas kyi gzhung rnams las/ oṃ sa taṃ ke swāhā/ sems can thams cad chos kyi grags pa'i snyan pa bsam gyis bzod pa thob gyur cig gsungs pa yod pas glo bur du 'phan bzang 'di 'dra 'bul rgyu byung ba ni/ dpal ldan chos grags kyi mtshan tshang zhing tshig ris la chos kyi grags pa'i snyan pa 'byung ba dang 'grigs pas/ ngo mtshar rgya mtsho yin min shes ldan gzu bo'i blo can rnams kyis gzigs shig/ //zhus so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ gdung mchog nas rnam 'grel gzhung skyor mdzad skabs 'phan 'bul ba'i zhal byang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
